create_rnn_state_encoder: create an RNNStateEncoder with GRU or LSTM for encoding states in reinforcement learning
build_rnn_with_orthogonal_init: build an RNN encoder that initializes weights with orthogonal initialization and biases to zero
run_single_forward_pass: run a single forward pass through the RNN encoder on a non-sequence input tensor
run_sequence_forward_pass: run a sequence forward pass through the RNN encoder on flattened T-by-N input tensors with masking
review_mask_hidden_method: review the RNNStateEncoder mask hidden state method that applies masks to LSTM or GRU hidden states
